description: 主修软件工程，ENSF项目。课程涵盖数据结构与算法、操作系统、计算机网络、数据库系统、软件设计与架构。曾参与多个全栈开发与工业数据采集项目，具备独立完成完整项目的能力。
description_en: Major in Software Engineering, ENSF program. Coursework includes Data Structures & Algorithms, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Database Systems, Software Design & Architecture. Participated in multiple full-stack development and industrial data acquisition projects, demonstrating ability to independently deliver complete projects from concept to working prototype.
